Panels (a)-(c) are produced by
[`script/FigureS2.R`](https://github.com/AgueroZZ/immgenT-GP-analysis/blob/main/script/FigureS2.R)
and panel (d) by
[`script/FigureS2d.R`](https://github.com/AgueroZZ/immgenT-GP-analysis/blob/main/script/FigureS2d.R).
The code below is shown for reference; the images are its pre-rendered output.

## Setup

```{r figs2-setup, code=code_for("../script/FigureS2.R", c("^", "Load data")), eval=FALSE}
```

## (a) GP30 loading across Tz subsets {#figs2a}

```{r figs2a-code, code=code_for("../script/FigureS2.R", "S2A"), eval=FALSE}
```

```{r figs2a-img, echo=FALSE, out.width="32%"}
knitr::include_graphics("assets/FigureS2/S2A.png")
```

::: {.figcaption}
**Extended Data Fig. 2a.** Box plots showing the distribution of GP30 activity
across Tz subsets—iNKT, MAIT, and other Tz cells (that is, Tz cells that are
neither iNKT nor MAIT)—and all other T cells.
:::

same clusters cell by cell.
